title: MHT-CET Maths
summary: MHT-CET Maths past questions from 68 shifts, 2021 to 2026, five a day. Questions asked again in another shift and the question types that keep coming back come first, ranked together by how often they were asked, then every other question.
note: Repeats are counted across the 68 shifts, May 2021 to May 2026; a shift is one paper. Groups were found by a chapter-by-chapter reading (scripts/homework/REVIEW_BRIEF_CET.md), made consistent and joined across chapters in the main session.
